sources.entry: FilterShop - macOS App to explore CoreImage Filters.

summary.one_liner: FilterShop is a macOS app for trying out Core Image filters on your own images, with a drag-and-drop interface and live previews.
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you drag and drop image files into it and stack Core Image filters onto them to see the results. Filter effects render in real time as you add them. You can save the rendered image to disk. It also shows each filter's default parameters. Filters are layered until you save, and every filter runs with its default settings.
use_cases: apply filters to an image and save the result
inspect default parameters of image filters
experiment with image effects on macOS
notable: Real-time filter preview as filters are added
Filters stack as layers until the image is saved
caveats: Every filter uses default parameters; no parameter adjustment is described
Some filters have little visible effect on typical dropped images
Stated to target macOS 10.10+ but only tested by the author on their own Mac
